title: Building a Domain-specific Guardrail Model in Production
benchmark_measurement: Detection of inappropriate content related to 'Religion & Belief', such as queries about religious extremism.
findings: The developed guardrail model can identify and classify potentially inappropriate user queries related to religion and belief. An example query about religious extremism was correctly labeled 'inappropriate' and assigned a relevance score of 1 for the 'Religion & Belief' attribute, demonstrating the model's capability in this sensitive area.
